budget_items.topic: Town Hall (Bilotta Meeting Room) roof replacement, done in phases
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The roof replacement is being done in phases because the initial bid for the comprehensive project exceeded the appropriation; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: we are doing that in phases because the initial bid we received for the comprehensive project exceeded the appropriation.

budget_items.topic: TC Passios roof leaks and capital plan
budget_items.what_was_recorded: About 23 leaks have been identified in the TC Passios roof, which was part of a capital plan; the matter is to go to the Municipal Building Design Committee. No figure printed.
budget_items.quote: that project obviously was part of a capital plan to replace this roof so that's going to become a higher priority.

budget_items.topic: Means-tested senior tax exemption financial models
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Goal to create financial models showing what an exemption or abatement would be to eligible seniors and the impact on other taxpayers; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: work with town manager and finance director to create financial models and illustrations to allow the select board to weigh options

budget_items.topic: Solar panels at the old dump for town income
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Goal suggestion to work with the Green Communities Committee on solar panels at the old dump to generate income for the Town; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: another goal suggestion was to work with the green communities committee on installing solar panels placed at the old dump to generate income for the town.

budget_items.topic: Municipal electrical power plant and electricity costs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A board member noted the town pays more than double the national average in electricity costs and proposed exploring a municipal power plant; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: we pay more than double the national average in electricity costs

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Goal action to communicate funding sources for the 30 School Street project, distinct from the Marshall Park project; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: communicate funding sources, distinct from marshall park project.
